response.incident_summary: Between 14:49:49 and 14:49:51 UTC on 2026-06-28, the checkout-service in the checkout namespace on demo-cluster experienced a high error rate triggered by a synthetic payment dependency failure (ev_alert_001). A flood of logs (ev_log_template_003) and metrics (ev_metric_006, ev_metric_002, ev_metric_003) confirm that the payment dependency became unavailable, causing 40 HTTP 503 responses (ev_log_template_002) and a 1523% spike in p95 latency (ev_metric_004). The incident is contained to pod checkout-api-7c9d (cncc-demo-12345) and was preceded by a 'Failure mode changed' log (ev_log_template_004) that likely enabled the fault injection.

primary_hypothesis.claim: A synthetic payment dependency failure, enabled just before the incident, caused all subsequent checkout errors and latency degradation.

domain_reasoning.fault_events: ev_alert_001 defines the incident trigger: a payment dependency failure causing HTTP 503 responses. It ties the event to known synthetic fault injection.
domain_reasoning.log_text: ev_log_template_003 ('Payment dependency unavailable after retries') appears 28.4% of logs, directly matching the failure mode. ev_log_template_002 records 40 failed requests. ev_log_template_004 logs 'Failure mode changed enabled=true' moments before the failure, indicating deliberate fault enablement.
